messages:
rachel: Quick sync — noticed a recurring tail pattern in prod this morning. micro-window alignment seems to be starving a subset of tenants when short/long mix hits the allocator. dump attached.
omar: Seen it too. P95 bump ~180ms for small requests, P50 fine. link: https://grafana/redwood/streams?id=miniwin-alignment
linh: Can you paste the trace? curious if it's enqueue ordering or eviction churn
rachel: ```
# trace snippet
req: tenant=alpha, len=32, enqueue=161952.120
req: tenant=beta, len=1024, enqueue=161952.121
coalesce: window=8ms -> batched len=1056
evict: tenant=alpha evicted to make room -> delay 120ms
``` 
rachel: TL;DR: small reqs get late-evicted when large reqs join same micro-window. continuous batching tries to keep cold slots full and ends up preempting fast-paths.
tomas: Two obvious knobs: 1) prefer-fill for windows < Xms (favor smalls), 2) soft-eviction credits so previously-idle tenants get priority next window
omar: tradeoff: prefer-fill reduces packing efficiency and could raise overall cost; soft-eviction adds state and complexity to the allocator
linh: Could we do a hybrid: prefer-fill when observed short-request ratio > threshold AND window fill-rate < target? keep default packing otherwise
rachel: That matches what I was thinking. Also add a lightweight lease-tag so we don't evict a slot that just won a tiny-ticket < Yms ago. cheap to check.
tomas: Implementation notes: lease-tag needs to survive across coalescer threads. we can stash tag in slot metadata (uint32) and update on enqueue/dequeue. low overhead.
linh: Observability — add metric: evicted_after_win_ms and small_request_tail_by_tenant. need to verify fairness improvement after rollout
omar: Rollout plan: feature-flag pref-fill + synthetic bench (mixed short/long) -> perf-canary in dev -> 1% prod -> 10% -> 100%. watch unit-cost and P95 small-req.
rachel: RFC follow-up items for writeup: 1) spec pref-fill heuristic, 2) soft-evict credit lifecycle, 3) lease-tag semantics and concurrency, 4) rollout telemetry. I can draft.
infra-bot: CI check started for branch rachel/miniwin-prefill (build 3224). :building_construction:
omar: Thanks — ping when draft is up, will review and add cost modeling notes.
